title: Playful Baby with Toy Bucket on Head, 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful black and white deckled-edge snapshot from June 1956 capturing an infant or young toddler sitting indoors and playfully balancing a small toy bucket upside down on their head like a helmet. The baby wears a light-colored sleeper or onesie and smiles with wide-eyed excitement. The top white margin bears the stamp 'JUN • 56'.
